## 检查清单 / Checklist

- [ ] 变更范围聚焦，没有夹带无关重构或格式化。 / The change is focused and contains no unrelated refactoring or formatting.
- [ ] 已保留用户数据、现有配置和兼容边界，或在下方说明破坏性变更。 / User data, configuration, and compatibility boundaries are preserved or documented below.
- [ ] 已运行直接相关的检查和 `git diff --check`。 / Relevant checks and `git diff --check` have been run.
- [ ] 没有提交密钥、令牌、本地状态、构建产物或调试输出。 / No secrets, tokens, local state, build output, or debug output are included.
- [ ] 功能状态或限制变化时，已同步施工文档和 README。 / Implementation docs and READMEs are updated when capability or limitations change.
- [ ] 提交标题符合 `type(scope): 中文说明 / English summary`。 / The commit title follows `type(scope): 中文说明 / English summary`.
